title: US teens (13-17) who have used an AI companion app

source.name: Talk, Trust, and Trade-Offs: How and Why Teens Use AI Companions
source.publisher: Common Sense Media (survey fielded by NORC at the University of Chicago)

notes: Nationally representative survey of 1,060 US teens ages 13-17, fielded April-May 2025. 72% have used an AI companion app (e.g. Character.AI, Replika) at least once; 52% qualify as regular users (a few times a month or more); 13% use one daily.

points.label: Have used one at least once
